description: This file defines the 'Required' validation rule class used within the OrangeHRM system to ensure that certain input fields are not empty. It includes the class implementation, constructor, and validation logic, utilizing a trait for emptiness checks.

classes.name: Required
classes.description: Validation rule class that checks if a given input is present and optionally not an empty string, depending on configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule with a flag to exclude empty strings from validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the input, returning true if input is considered present (and not empty if configured).
